mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_proposal (title, content, category, submitter, status, deadline, regdate, updatedate) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{submitter}, 'SUBMITTED', #{deadline}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pno, title, content, category, submitter, status, total_score AS totalScore, deadline, regdate, updatedate FROM tbl_proposal WHERE pno = #{pno}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_proposal SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, deadline = #{deadline}, updatedate = NOW() WHERE pno = #{pno}

choose.otherwise: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR submitter LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

SELECT pno, title, content, category, submitter, status, total_score AS totalScore, deadline, regdate, updatedate FROM tbl_proposal
ORDER BY pno DESC LIMIT #{pageStart}, #{perPageNum}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_proposal_attach (pno, saved_name, original_name, filesize, regdate) VALUES (#{pno}, #{savedName}, #{originalName}, #{filesize}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ano, pno, saved_name AS savedName, original_name AS originalName, filesize, regdate FROM tbl_proposal_attach WHERE pno = #{pno} ORDER BY ano
